## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), see CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] New behaviour has a unit test, and `python -m unittest discover -s tests/unit -t tests/unit` passes
- [ ] If `VERSION` in `app/bro/core.py` goes up, the commit message starts with it (`1.5.2: ...`)
- [ ] New files start with `# SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later`
- [ ] No IP addresses, tickets, keys, e-mail addresses or names in code, tests or screenshots
